_national.varieties: IG, DOC, Reserva and Gran Reserva wines must come from the INV list of quality vinifera varieties (Res. 30/2024: e.g. Malbec, Bonarda, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Criolla Chica, Torrontes Riojano, Chardonnay, Pedro Gimenez).
_national.labelling: Ley 25.163 (1999) sets three tiers. Indicacion de Procedencia (IP): table and regional wines, at least 80% from the named area. Indicacion Geografica (IG): quality wine from an area no larger than a province, grapes produced, harvested, made and bottled in it; if made or bottled elsewhere, the label must pair the vineyard area with the wider area that contains both. Denominacion de Origen Controlada (DOC): quality wine from selected varieties, grown, made, aged and bottled in the delimited area under rules set by its Consejo de Promocion. Blends from different IGs or DOCs may not use any of them. Variety 85% (two or three named varieties must total 85%, in descending order, with any under 10% stated); vintage 85%. Every geographic name on a label must be registered with INV. "Viñedo unico" (single vineyard) allowed under INV rules.
_national.ageing: Reserva: at least 135 kg grapes per 100 l; reds aged at least 12 months, whites and roses 6 months, from when the wine is stable. Gran Reserva: at least 140 kg per 100 l; reds 18 months (24 until Res. 14/2019), whites and roses 12 months. "Roble" only for wines treated with oak.
_national.other: In 2023 INV listed 110 IGs and 2 DOCs (Lujan de Cuyo, San Rafael); several IGs have been added since.

ar-lujan-de-cuyo.varieties: At least 85% Malbec, up to 15% other varieties (rules relaunched in 2023).
ar-lujan-de-cuyo.ageing: At least 18 months before release, including at least 6 months in oak.
ar-lujan-de-cuyo.labelling: DOC established in 1989 and the first in the Americas; bottled at origin. Vineyards between 800 and 1,100 m, at least 5,000 vines/ha on VSP, vines at least 10 years old, yields capped; drip irrigation now allowed. 11 member wineries in 2023 (e.g. Lagarde, Luigi Bosca, Nieto Senetiner, Norton, Terrazas de los Andes).
